label: Artemis II Mission Status
delta: Day 44 post-splashdown: IFT-12 FLEW May 22 — Ship 39 nominal Indian Ocean splashdown; Booster 19 lost (boostback anomaly). FAA mishap investigation underway. Artemis III ICPS spacer confirmed; MSFC fabrication begun.
deltaNote: Day 44: Artemis II crew at JSC Houston. IFT-12 launched May 22 at 22:30 UTC from OLP-2, Starbase. Ship 39 (Starship V3) successfully reached suborbital trajectory, deployed 22 Starlink V3 simulators, and splashed down nominally in the Indian Ocean — V3 heat shield confirmed to have 'held well' (Elon Musk, May 23). Booster 19 (33 Raptor 3 engines, all lit at liftoff) lost after boostback burn failure: multiple engines failed to fire during boostback, causing uncontrolled spin and Gulf of Mexico crash. FAA launched mishap assessment expected to conclude by June 2026; SpaceX must receive FAA sign-off before IFT-13. NASA-required docking port and propellant-transfer hardware on Ship 39 survived the flight (structural milestone for Artemis III HLS qualification; no active transfer test conducted). Artemis III confirmed to fly with structural spacer instead of ICPS — sole remaining ICPS reserved for Artemis IV (2028 crewed landing). MSFC fabricating spacer barrel section and rings.
